notes: New: drag the caption up/down right on the preview to set its height — hover over the caption on the video, grab it and move it vertically (a subtle grip appears); the Bottom-margin slider and number follow live, and it works in every format. Horizontal position stays centred (vertical only, as intended). Fix: the ⧉ Style→all button (copy the active hook's caption style onto every hook in the pack) is back — it now stays visible the whole time a pack is loaded, including while you're editing a single hook (that's exactly when you want to propagate the look), instead of hiding the moment you opened a hook. Cleanup: removed two panels that weren't pulling their weight — 'Custom styles' and 'Export one clip'. Saving and importing styles now live entirely in the Presets rail (＋ Save / ⤴ Import), and the real export path is Send to Compose → Render (the board), so the extra single-clip export panel is gone. Presets are now yours to manage: hover any ★ custom preset to reveal a ✕ and delete it, and a saved preset that shares a built-in's name now overrides it — so you can re-save a built-in under its own name to edit/calibrate it by hand, no assistant needed. Transcription section redesigned: the Text ⇄ Words toggle is now a right-aligned segmented pill (bigger, clearly clickable, filled accent when active) sitting above a single field wrapper so the field and the language sticker no longer jump when you switch; taller transcript/words fields make use of the space. New Transcript view switch: Text ⇄ Words. Text is the usual editor (unchanged). Words is a navigator — click a word to jump the video there, and while it plays the caption currently on screen is highlighted, so you always see where you are. Editing stays in Text (Words is read-only navigation), so the main editing field is untouched. Section Enable toggles fixed: they now show in the section HEADER whether it's open or closed (before, a closed section hid the toggle and it collapsed to a stray white dot), sit left of the chevron without overlapping, and flip on/off without opening the section — so turning Stroke/Shadow/Scrim/Plate/Karaoke on or off is one click. Slider values now use a clean stepper: side ‹ › arrows + a mono number + mouse-wheel (no more tiny native spinners). Right-side sections are now an accordion — opening one (Transcription / Base text / Smart captions, or Stroke/Shadow/etc.) collapses its neighbours, so the open one always fits and nothing gets pushed off-screen or hidden (with a soft open animation + auto-scroll to the top). Keep-together phrases are now editable tablets — ＋ to add (type + Enter), ✕ to remove — and auto-save. Scene cuts now show as clickable chips (🎬 timecodes): click one to jump the playhead there, ✕ to remove — no more hunting for a cut on a long timeline. Save-preset button is now always visible (green) next to the presets.Last caption no longer hangs over the ending — everywhere. The final word's transcriber end (often stretched to the end of the audio) used to freeze the last caption over trailing b-roll / the packshot; three places forced this (build_events, the 'hold last caption to end' in preview, and hold_last in the renderer + the 'exact' server preview). Now the last caption gets a short readable tail (~1.5s) and is trimmed to a scene cut if one was placed before the packshot — preview, exact and render all match. New: invisible caption break — press Enter (or type *) between words to split the caption at that spot; it's invisible in the burned caption and layout-independent, so you can keep punctuation on and still control splits. Replaces the old Manual line breaks toggle; the Punctuation toggle now sits in its place. keep-together phrases now persist across updates (stored next to the shared library / in ~/.assembler, not inside the auto-updated code).
